entries.name: tree-body-108-not-accept#0
entries.description: Output tree, size-flagged and segregated (header 0x18): BoolToSigmaProp(LogicalNot^108(placeholder 0 = true)). Every expression node takes a value level and the placeholder has no data level, so the deepest node sits at 110 = MaxTreeDepth. Round-trip identity.

entries.name: tree-body-109-not-reject#1
entries.description: The same tree with 109 LogicalNot: 111 levels. DeserializeCallDepthExceeded is a SerializerException, not a ValidationException, so the size flag does not soften it into an UnparsedErgoTree: the tx is rejected at parse. An impl that degrades on it, or has no counter, round-trips the tx: the over-accept.
